us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump administration proposes new tariffs on China, EU and other partners
bullets: Officials outlined additional duties on China and several major trading partners.
The proposal targets subsidized production that Washington says disadvantages U.S. manufacturers.
The tariffs remain at the proposal stage with no firm implementation timeline.

articles.title: Small plane crash off Mississippi coast kills six people
bullets: A Cessna 210 crashed Tuesday in the Gulf of Mexico off Mississippi.
The Coast Guard said four adults and two children were killed.
The FAA and NTSB will investigate the crash.

articles.title: Fort Hood shooter asks federal court to delay firing-squad execution
bullets: Nidal Hasan sought more time to challenge his death sentence.
His execution had been scheduled for next week.
A federal hearing was set for Wednesday morning.

articles.title: Young Republicans call for party reset after midterm losses
bullets: Young GOP activists met in Texas after damaging midterm results.
Democrats won major Texas statewide races, AP reported.
Participants urged the party to address affordability and generational concerns.

articles.title: GLP-1 weight-loss drugs reshape Thanksgiving eating habits
bullets: More Americans using GLP-1 medications report smaller holiday portions.
Doctors say the drugs can reduce cravings and increase fullness.
The trend is changing some food-centered social traditions.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Canary Islands record nearly 2,000 migrant arrivals in one day
bullets: Spanish authorities reported 1,990 arrivals on 15 boats Tuesday.
Officials said it was a single-day record for the archipelago.
The surge comes ahead of Spain’s national election.

articles.title: Libyan officers die after Ukrainian drone attack on Russian warship
bullets: Libya’s eastern forces said two naval officers died from wounds.
The attack opened a new theater in the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
The Libyan National Army vowed retaliation.

articles.title: Pope Leo criticizes failure of UN climate talks
bullets: Pope Leo XIV lamented the lack of agreement after COP31 talks.
He warned climate-linked extreme events are becoming more frequent.
The talks ended without an overarching deal on fossil fuels.

articles.title: Amnesty urges war-crimes probe into Ethiopian shelling in Tigray
bullets: Amnesty said shelling of civilian areas should be independently investigated.
The group verified 14 civilian deaths in attacks on Alamata.
Renewed fighting has raised fears of wider conflict with Eritrea.

articles.title: Melania Trump announces seventh wartime child reunification effort
bullets: The White House said another group of Ukrainian and Russian children returned home.
The effort has reunited 43 children with families, AP reported.
The first lady framed the work as humanitarian intervention amid war.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India-focused headlines from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: India urges human-centric approach to AI in armed conflict at UN
bullets: India addressed a UN Security Council debate on AI and conflict.
Officials flagged risks of misuse by terrorist groups.
New Delhi called for safeguards centered on human responsibility.

articles.title: Supreme Court seeks responses on CEC protest detentions
bullets: The Supreme Court asked the Centre and Delhi government to respond.
The matter concerns detentions during a CEC-related protest.
The case was listed among Wednesday’s national headlines.

articles.title: Top Court denies interim bail to Sharjeel Imam and Umar Khalid
bullets: The Supreme Court declined interim bail on Wednesday.
Sharjeel Imam and Umar Khalid remain in custody.
The matter appeared in NDTV’s latest India updates.

articles.title: Madurai collector apologizes in Supreme Court over Deepathoon lamp issue
bullets: The district collector filed a preliminary status report.
He gave an unconditional apology over the November 24 lamp-lighting issue.
The report was submitted before the Supreme Court.

articles.title: Centre expands tribal welfare outreach to 76,000 villages
bullets: The Centre is building a grassroots network for tribal welfare schemes.
The outreach aims to cover 76,000 villages.
Economic Times listed the update among November 25 national headlines.

stocks.label: US Stocks
stocks.subtitle: Key U.S. market movers and trading stories

articles.title: AI stocks drag U.S. indexes lower after Monday rebound fades
bullets: AP said AI stocks pulled the market lower Tuesday.
The move followed a sharp Nvidia-led rally Monday.
Indexes remained volatile after recent all-time highs.

articles.title: Nvidia shares slump as Huang comeback rally reverses
bullets: Nvidia fell after surging on Jensen Huang’s reinstatement.
AP reported the broader AI rout continued Wednesday.
Investors reassessed governance concerns and AI valuations.

articles.title: Anthropic falls below IPO price after record market debut
bullets: Anthropic shares dropped below their $83 IPO price in premarket trading.
The decline added pressure to AI-linked stocks.
The IPO had been billed as the largest on record.

articles.title: Dell jumps after raising fiscal 2027 revenue forecast
bullets: Dell lifted its fiscal 2027 revenue forecast to $202 billion.
The update followed stronger-than-expected quarterly results.
Shares were highlighted among Wednesday premarket movers.

articles.title: Analog Devices and HPE lead Tuesday’s S&P 500 decliners
bullets: ChartMill cited Analog Devices and Hewlett Packard Enterprise among biggest losers.
Both stocks fell sharply in Tuesday’s session.
Tech weakness offset gains in most other S&P 500 sectors.

articles.title: Sanofi agrees to buy Insmed in $41 billion cash deal
bullets: Sanofi will acquire Insmed for $175 per share in cash.
The companies announced the $41 billion transaction Tuesday.
The deal expands Sanofi’s pharmaceutical portfolio.

articles.title: Nvidia board faces scrutiny after reinstating Jensen Huang
bullets: Nvidia’s board unanimously brought Huang back as CEO.
The reversal followed his resignation days earlier.
Critics questioned governance and outside political pressure.

articles.title: New U.S. tariff proposal targets subsidized foreign manufacturing
bullets: The administration plans higher tariffs on several major trading partners.
Officials said the move addresses subsidies and trade barriers.
The plan could affect imports from China, Europe and Asia.

articles.title: Best Buy shows signs of retail recovery after difficult years
bullets: Axios reported stronger momentum for the Minnesota-based retailer.
Gaming demand and advertising sales supported the business.
The company joins Target in a brighter Twin Cities retail outlook.

articles.title: The Economist reports growth in subscriptions and operating profit
bullets: The Economist’s consumer unit remains its largest business segment.
Axios reported operating profit grew 24% to £25 million.
The company is also monetizing video through sponsorships and platforms.

tech.label: Tech
tech.subtitle: Top technology stories and AI-sector developments

articles.title: Huawei convicted in U.S. over bank fraud and sanctions-related charges
bullets: A U.S. jury convicted Huawei on 10 of 12 criminal counts.
Charges included bank fraud and conspiracy to steal trade secrets.
Huawei was acquitted of racketeering and obstruction counts.

articles.title: AI market selloff deepens after Nvidia leadership turmoil
bullets: AP reported renewed selling across AI-linked stocks.
Nvidia and Anthropic both weakened after earlier surges.
The moves reflected fading enthusiasm after Huang’s return.

articles.title: Nvidia chip-diversion network to China draws renewed scrutiny
bullets: Le Monde reported on networks allegedly routing Nvidia chips to China.
The report connected the issue to the broader Huang scandal.
Documents reportedly tied hardware to a Shanghai-area data center.

articles.title: Anthropic’s post-IPO slide tests investor appetite for AI
bullets: Anthropic shares fell below the $83 IPO price in premarket trading.
The move followed last week’s record-setting public listing.
Investors remain focused on AI profitability and infrastructure costs.

articles.title: RTX 5090 shortages hit major PC makers and U.S. retailers
bullets: TechRadar reported Lenovo, Dell and HP ran out of RTX 5090 desktops.
Standalone cards have become rarer at U.S. retail outlets.
Demand is tied to gaming, rendering and local AI workloads.
